articles.summary: SAN DIEGO , Jan. 15, 2026 (GLOBE NEWSWIRE) -- Encore Capital Group, Inc. (Nasdaq:ECPG), an international specialty finance company, announced today that it will release its financial results for the fourth quarter 2025 on Wednesday, February 25, 2026 , after the market closes.
articles.title: Encore Capital Group to Announce Fourth Quarter 2025 Financial Results on February 25
